texts.en: Progressive muscle relaxation (PMR), 18 areas — 9 min practice

texts.ko: 지금부터 안내에 따라 부위별로 근육을 긴장시키고 이완합니다. 통증이 있거나 불편한 부위는 힘주기를 생략하고 편하게 쉬세요. 불편하면 언제든 활동을 종료할 수 있습니다.
texts.en: Following the guidance, you'll tense and then relax your muscles one area at a time. If an area hurts or feels uncomfortable, skip tensing it and just rest. You can end the activity anytime if you feel uncomfortable.
PMR practice by body area — 18 areas
Right hand · forearm
Right upper arm
Left hand · forearm
Left upper arm
Forehead
Eyes · cheeks
Mouth · jaw
Neck
Shoulders
Shoulder blades · back
Chest · belly
Buttocks
Right thigh
Right calf
Right foot
Left thigh
Left calf
Left foot

texts.ko: 등과 머리가 편하게 지지되는 의자에 앉아 주세요. 각 부위의 설명을 듣고 시작 신호가 나오면 통증 없는 범위에서 가볍게 힘을 줍니다. 힘을 빼라는 안내가 나오면 편하게 쉽니다. 숨을 참지 마세요. 통증이 있거나 불편한 부위는 건너뛰고, 원하면 언제든 종료할 수 있습니다.
texts.en: Sit in a chair that comfortably supports your back and head. Listen to the instructions for each area, and when you hear the start signal, tense gently within a pain-free range. When you're told to let go, relax comfortably. Don't hold your breath. Skip any area that hurts or feels uncomfortable, and you can stop anytime you like.

texts.ko: 오른손을 가볍게 쥐어 손과 아래팔의 긴장을 느낄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to make a light fist and feel the tension in your right hand and forearm.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 오른팔의 팔꿈치를 굽혀 위팔에 가볍게 힘줄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to bend your right elbow and gently tense your upper arm.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 왼손을 가볍게 쥐어 손과 아래팔의 긴장을 느낄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to make a light fist and feel the tension in your left hand and forearm.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 왼팔의 팔꿈치를 굽혀 위팔에 가볍게 힘줄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to bend your left elbow and gently tense your upper arm.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 눈썹을 살짝 들어 이마에 긴장을 줄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to raise your eyebrows slightly and tense your forehead.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 눈을 가볍게 감아 눈 주변과 볼에 긴장을 줄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to close your eyes gently and tense around your eyes and cheeks.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 턱이 불편하지 않은 범위에서 입을 조금 벌릴 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to open your mouth a little, as far as is comfortable for your jaw.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 목이 불편하면 건너뛰세요. 편안한 범위에서 고개를 조금 뒤로 기울릴 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: If your neck feels uncomfortable, skip this. Get ready to tilt your head back slightly, as is comfortable.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 어깨를 귀 쪽으로 살짝 올릴 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to raise your shoulders slightly toward your ears.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 양쪽 날개뼈를 가볍게 모아 등 근육에 힘줄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to gently squeeze your shoulder blades together and tense your back.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 숨을 편안히 들이쉬며 가슴과 배의 움직임을 느껴보세요. 숨은 참지 마세요.
texts.en: Breathe in comfortably and feel your chest and belly move. Don't hold your breath.

texts.ko: 숨을 참지 말고 편안히 움직임을 느껴보세요.
texts.en: Don't hold your breath; just feel the movement comfortably.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 엉덩이 근육에 가볍게 힘줄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to gently tense your buttock muscles.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 오른쪽 허벅지 근육에 가볍게 힘줄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to gently tense the muscles of your right thigh.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 쥐가 나지 않도록 오른발 끝을 몸 쪽으로 살짝 당길 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: To avoid a cramp, get ready to pull your right toes gently toward you.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 오른발 발가락을 가볍게 오므릴 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to gently curl the toes of your right foot.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 왼쪽 허벅지 근육에 가볍게 힘줄 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to gently tense the muscles of your left thigh.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 쥐가 나지 않도록 왼발 끝을 몸 쪽으로 살짝 당길 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: To avoid a cramp, get ready to pull your left toes gently toward you.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 왼발 발가락을 가볍게 오므릴 준비를 하세요.
texts.en: Get ready to gently curl the toes of your left foot.
Now tense gently.
Now let go and relax comfortably.
Rest comfortably and get ready for the next area.

texts.ko: 모든 부위의 안내가 끝났습니다. 몸의 힘을 편하게 풀고 평소 호흡을 이어가세요. 잠시 앉아서 주변을 살핀 뒤 천천히 움직이세요.
texts.en: The guidance for all areas is complete. Let your body relax and keep breathing normally. Sit for a moment, look around you, and then move slowly.

texts.ko: P18은 20분 녹음 안내 PMR 연구다. LUMI 수행 대본은 HealthyWA·CCI 공개 안내를 참고해 별도 작성하며 원 연구 대본 및 효과의 동등성은 확인되지 않았다.
texts.en: P18 is a PMR study with a 20-minute recorded guide. LUMI's practice script was written separately, referring to public guides from HealthyWA and CCI, and its equivalence to the original study script and effect hasn't been confirmed.
Instructions
Tense or notice sensations
Let go and rest
Get ready for the next area
Not validated with adults in Korea.
